title: Find it by what it is, not by its product ID
sub: Catalog search by type, size and class. The custom hood is configured within its limits, not built in Excel.

title: A Type B2 can’t use a canopy
sub: Type B2 cabinets must be hard-ducted. Two ways out, each priced; the rep picks with the dealer.
vo: Every line is checked before it's priced. A Type B2 cabinet can't use a canopy connection.

title: The room can’t hold hood airflow
sub: Eight hoods need more makeup air than the room supplies. Agentforce explains and proposes the fix; the rep approves.
vo: The room can't hold the hood airflow, so Agentforce proposes variable-air-volume hoods.

title: A purified rinse needs purified water
sub: The lab has tap water only, so the quote adds a point-of-use RO/DI system: the cross-sell, caught at quote time.
vo: A purified rinse needs purified water, so the quote adds the water system.
